description: Reified 'Family Relations' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Family Relative.description: This field is used to link the documented person to another person with whom they are related via a particular familial status.

Family Relation.description: This field is used to record the property, as a formal type, represented in the familial status ascribed to the documented person.

Family Relation Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the family status ascribed to the documented person.
